Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning shooting on certain countyowned lands.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to shooting; and adding a new section to chapter77.36 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 77.36 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any county composed entirely of islands, any of which areconnected with the mainland by state highway, may, after the effectivedate of this section, allow shooting on countyowned lands that containa trail system constructed or maintained for purposes of outdoorrecreation or on countyowned waterfront property surrounded on allsides by homes only where: (a) The county sheriff's office is provided with the resourcesnecessary to secure the safety of all persons and property on andaround such countyowned lands available for shooting; (b) The board of county commissioners holds, at least annually, apublic hearing on the issue of shooting on such countyowned lands; and (c) Notice of the dates and specific countyowned lands on whichshooting will be allowed is given by publication in a newspaper of p. 1 SSB 6598general circulation in the county at least one week prior to, andweekly during, the use of such lands for shooting. (2) Notwithstanding subsection (1) of this section, a countycomposed entirely of islands, any of which are connected with themainland by state highway, may not, after the effective date of thissection, allow shooting on countyowned lands that contain a trailsystem constructed or maintained for purposes of outdoor recreation oron countyowned waterfront property surrounded on all sides by homeswhere the county sheriff makes a written finding that the sheriff'soffice has not been provided with the resources necessary to secure thesafety of all persons and property on and around such countyownedlands available for shooting and provides copies of such a writtenfinding to the county clerk and the county commissioners. (3) Notwithstanding subsections (1)(a), (1)(b), and (2) of thissection, a county composed entirely of islands, any of which areconnected with the mainland by state highway, may allow shooting oncountyowned lands that contain a trail system constructed ormaintained for purposes of outdoor recreation or on countyownedwaterfront property surrounded on all sides by homes in coordinationwith a special hunt authorized by the department under RCW 77.12.150,upon a written finding by both the department and the county that agame animal population poses a danger to persons, property, or habitatwithin the county and after providing notice pursuant to subsection(1)(c) of this section.
